# REQ: LANG-1031 LANG-1032 load("@rules_go//go:def.bzl", "go_library", "go_binary") go_library( name = "highlight", srcs = glob(["*.go"], exclude = ["*_test.go"]), importpath = "github.com/polestorm/gohighlightgo/highlight", visibility = ["//visibility:public"], ) def _impl(ctx): out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".txt") ctx.actions.write(out, "hello\n") return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))] greet = rule(implementation = _impl, attrs = {"count": attr.int(default = 1)})
